name: ductus-rules
description: Ductus hard rules from CLAUDE.md that must hold through shell wrappers.
author: Ductus

rules.name: block-git-add-all
rules.reason: CLAUDE.md: stage with 'git add <paths>', never a blanket add.

rules.name: block-git-commit-all
rules.reason: CLAUDE.md: stage explicit paths with 'git add <paths>' before committing.

rules.name: block-git-commit-no-verify
rules.reason: Hooks run lint and the secrets scan; fix the failure instead of skipping them.

rules.name: block-git-push-no-verify
rules.reason: CLAUDE.md: tests must be green before a push; do not skip the pre-push checks.
